categories.main_business_segments: L.K. Technology Holdings Limited operates primarily in three business segments: die-casting machines, plastic injection moulding machines, and computerized numerical controlled (CNC) machining centres. The company also engages in steel casting and related accessories manufacturing. Die-casting machines constitute the largest revenue segment, followed by plastic injection moulding and CNC machining centres.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in advanced die-casting technology including hot chamber and cold chamber die-casting machines, plastic injection moulding with high precision and servo drive systems, and CNC machining centres with high-speed capabilities. It has developed proprietary TPI semi-solid magnesium alloy forming technology that enhances energy efficiency and product strength. The firm also focuses on integrated die-casting solutions for large automotive components and magnesium alloy applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include automotive manufacturers, especially new energy vehicle OEMs, home appliance producers, packaging, toy manufacturers, and 3C electronics sectors. The company collaborates with leading global automotive OEMs, including German and Chinese new energy vehicle makers, and serves markets requiring high-precision injection moulding and machining solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates manufacturing and R&D bases in Mainland China (Shenzhen, Zhongshan, Ningbo, Shanghai, Fuxin, Kunshan), Taiwan, and Italy, with sales and service offices in the USA, India, Southeast Asia (notably Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia), and Europe. Mainland China is the largest revenue source, followed by Europe, North America, and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: L.K. Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the manufacturing supply chain, designing and producing machinery and equipment used by downstream manufacturers in automotive, electronics, and consumer goods industries. It also operates a casting factory producing cast iron/steel components, supporting upstream material processing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in magnesium alloy die-casting technology, integrated die-casting solutions for new energy vehicles, and semi-solid magnesium alloy forming processes. It emphasizes customized R&D to meet specific customer needs and forward-looking technology development targeting future market trends such as lightweight materials, AI integration, and intelligent manufacturing equipment. Collaboration with academic and industry partners is a key part of its innovation ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of die-casting machines, plastic injection moulding machines, CNC machining centres, and related accessories. The company also earns from steel casting operations and provides after-sales services including machine commissioning and mould optimization. Sales are primarily one-time product sales with ongoing service support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: L.K. Technology is one of the world’s largest die-casting machine manufacturers and holds a leading position in magnesium alloy die-casting technology. It competes globally with other machinery manufacturers in automotive and industrial sectors, leveraging technological innovation and customized solutions to differentiate itself. Its strategic partnerships and awards underscore its strong industry standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended March 2025, the Group reported revenue of HK$5.825 billion with a 24.5% growth in die-casting segment revenue. Gross profit margin was 27.4%, and net profit margin was 6.9%. Total assets reached HK$11.9 billion, reflecting a 9.2% increase year-on-year. The company demonstrated resilience amid complex market conditions with steady profitability and expanding asset base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: L.K. Technology offers advanced, energy-efficient, and high-precision die-casting and injection moulding machinery tailored for integrated and lightweight automotive components, especially for new energy vehicles. Its proprietary TPI semi-solid magnesium alloy forming technology and large-scale die-casting machines provide unique competitive advantages in product strength, precision, and environmental sustainability. The company’s extensive global service network and customized R&D capabilities further differentiate its offerings.
